What does the BJP envision for Punjab? How does it plan to address the state’s political and social challenges? And can Punjab safeguard its communal harmony while navigating an increasingly charged political landscape?
In an exclusive interview with Indian Express, Sunil Kumar Jakhar, BJP Punjab President, reflects on Punjab’s future, political direction and the issues shaping the run-up to the Assembly elections.
The Indian Express brings you comprehensive coverage of global & indian politics, election news, business news, world affairs, sports, entertainment, Bollywood, and public policy.
